seed.tagline: Postgres, a Node API and a TypeScript SDK from your rulebook.
seed.description: Adds a backend/ folder built from the project's rulebook: the Postgres schema, vw_* views, calc functions and seed data; a Node + Express API over those views; a TypeScript SDK with every table and derived field; and the gold answer key (every derived value computed by Postgres) that other substrates are checked against.

replacements.label: Postgres schema
replacements.description: The schema the generated tables, views and functions live in.
